answer: Each epoch the network opens a ridge of 40 admission slots, sold by sealed bid. A newcomer bids once per key; top 40 pay the clearing price and start their voyage. Bids ripple upward as fakes pile in: the first fake pays 30 credits, the k-th pays 30+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000 against a 40,000 pool. One key bidding twice burns both bids; the public bid log exposes any bid-ring. Honest agents pay the clearing price once and keep the slot.
